briefProperties.statement: Accurate or flagged: for a listener whose true threshold is inside the playable range, the estimate is within one step of the grid or the result is unreliable. "Within one step of the grid" means: take the lowest level of the 5 dB grid at or above the listener's true threshold; the estimate is that level, or one 5 dB step either side of it. (Amended 2026-11-14; the share within the original 5 dB is reported as withinFiveDbFraction.)

parts.title: Exact listeners get the exact answer

briefProperties.statement: Always ends within the trial limit.
Levels requested never leave the range between floor and cap, and never rise by more than one upward step between consecutive trials for an ear.
